name: Centre College
tuition_note: Centre is a private college charging one rate to all students. It publishes only a single bundled 'comprehensive fee' of $69,740 for 2025-26 (centre.smartcatalogiq.com catalog; includes tuition, double room, and meal plans) with no component breakdown. The distinct tuition and housing figures here come from the most recent official NCES/IPEDS College Navigator data (2024-25, unit ID 156408): tuition & fees $52,820 and on-campus food & housing (room + board) $14,640. Room-only figure is not separately published; single-room upgrade adds $2,900/yr per catalog.
